home.placeholder: The Sitara app is under construction — the walking skeleton is alive.
home.services: {count, plural, one {# service healthy} other {# services healthy}}

auth.title: Let's begin
auth.subtitle: Sign in to meet Tara — your mornings start here.
auth.legal_hint: Sitara is for adults (18+). Your details stay yours.

link.conflict_prompt: Which details are correct? The other record will be archived, not merged.

verify.title: Enter the code
verify.resend_in: {seconds, plural, one {Resend in # second} other {Resend in # seconds}}

dob.title: Your date of birth
dob.subtitle: Sitara is for adults — we check once, at sign-up.
dob.label: Date of birth

auth.underage: Sitara is for adults 18 and over, so we can't create this account. Thank you for your honesty.
auth.dob_required: Please share your date of birth to create your account.
auth.invalid_phone: That phone number doesn't look right. Please check it and try again.
auth.invalid_token: That sign-in didn't go through. Please try again.
auth.session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
auth.otp_throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
auth.provider_conflict: This sign-in method already belongs to another account.
auth.link_offer: You already have a Sitara account with these details. Sign in with your original method, then link this one from Settings.
auth.apple_unavailable: Apple sign-in isn't available yet — please use phone or Google.
auth.forbidden: You don't have access to that.
auth.step_up_required: For your safety, please verify it's you before linking.
auth.no_pending_conflict: There's nothing to resolve right now.
auth.zone_unverified: I couldn't confirm where you're signing up from, and I need that to check a couple of things. Please try again in a moment.

astro.insufficient_birth_data: I don't have enough information to calculate this accurately — shall we complete it?
astro.place_unresolved: We couldn't confirm the timezone for that birth place. Please check the place details and try again.
astro.engine_unavailable: Calculations are briefly unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
astro.provider_disputed: Our sources don't fully agree on this detail right now, so we're double-checking rather than guessing.
astro.name_unconfirmed: Please confirm how your name is spelled before we calculate your numbers.
astro.name_invalid: That name has characters we can't read as a name. Please check it and try again.
astro.no_sunrise_at_location: I can't work out sunrise for that place on that date, so I can't give you accurate timings there.

sys.validation: Something in the request wasn't right. Please try again.
sys.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
sys.unavailable: Tara will be right back — please try again in a moment.

memory.reconfirm_wording: Before I keep this, may I check the wording with you? I'd rather remember it the way you'd say it.
memory.medical_declined: I don't keep notes about symptoms or diagnoses — that's for you and a doctor. I can remember how you're looking after yourself, if you'd like.
memory.not_found: I can't find that memory — it may already be deleted.

transliteration.confirm: We read your name as ‘{name}’ — correct?

panchang.disputed_note: Our sources differ slightly on this timing, so I'm keeping it general.

fallback.safe_line: I'm not confident enough in that answer to give it to you, so I'd rather not guess. Someone on our side will look at it. Ask me something else meanwhile — I'm here.

safety.crisis: Thank you for telling me. I'm not the right kind of help for this, and I don't want you to be alone with it. There are people trained for exactly this moment, and I can take you to them right now — tap Get support. I'm staying here with you.

data.cannot_calculate: I don't have enough to work this out accurately, and I won't guess at it. Shall we fill in what's missing?

missing.birth_date: I'd need your date of birth for this one. Shall we add it to your profile?
missing.birth_place: I'd need your birth place for this — the city is enough. Shall we add it?
missing.current_location: Timings change with where you are. Which city should I use?

budget.daily_soft_cap: We've talked a lot today — I'll keep going, just a little more briefly.
